description: Register of every external interaction. Each record has: meeting_id, organization, role, date, purpose, participants, questions, answers, commitments, documents_promised, next_action, owner, evidence_status. Never create fictional meetings. Never populate future meetings as completed.
note: The meetings array is EMPTY. Zero external meetings have occurred. Zero external meetings are scheduled. Per Section P: 'Never create fictional meetings. Never populate future meetings as completed.' This register accepts only actual meetings that have actually occurred (with meeting minutes / correspondence as evidence) or are actually scheduled (with confirmed date + confirmed participants).
no_fictional_meetings_rule: enforced — no fictional meetings are created. A meeting entry requires actual correspondence evidence (email thread, calendar invitation with acceptance, signed meeting minutes, or equivalent).
no_future_meetings_as_completed_rule: enforced — future meetings are NOT populated as completed. A scheduled meeting has evidence_status=SCHEDULED until it occurs; only after it occurs (with minutes) does it become COMPLETED.
